title: Implement interactive TUI for 'cda config'
description:
Implement the interactive 'CLI UX' for 'cda config' using the chosen TUI library and the mapping helpers so users can view and toggle constraint activation.

In src/cli/commands/config.ts, extend runConfigCommand to: (1) load cda.config.json via the existing project config loader, surfacing CONFIG_ERROR if missing or malformed; (2) load constraints via loadConstraints({ constraintOverrides }) and convert them into UI state with the configConstraintState helpers; and (3) check process.stdout.isTTY and emit a CONFIG_ERROR with a clear message if no TTY is available.

Use the TUI library to present a scrollable list of constraints with markers like [x] (active) / [ ] (disabled), clearly distinguishing mandatory vs optional constraints and making mandatory ones non-toggleable. Implement key bindings such as Up/Down to move, Space/Enter to toggle optional constraints, Enter or Ctrl+S to save, and Esc or q to cancel, with an inline help line describing keys.

On cancel, exit without mutating configuration or writing files. On save, return the updated UI state to the rest of the command so that a separate persistence bead can handle writing cda.config.json.
